out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at each handwashing sink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. CDI: PAPER TOWELS PROVIDED TO SINK DURING INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Proper eating, tasting, drinking, or tobacco use

violations.title: Eating, Drinking, or Using Tobacco
violations.observation: Open drinking containers used or stored in a manner that may contaminate food, food contact surfaces or utensils. OBSERVED AN OPEN CAN OF POP AND A GLASS OF WATER ON THE PREP TABLE IN THE BACK.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees may have beverages in the kitchen areas as long as they are covered and consumed through a straw and stored in a manner that will prevent contamination to food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items. CDI: ITEMS WERE MOVED TO DESK AREA.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Access to Handwashing Sink
violations.observation: The handwashing facility located NEAR THE THREE-VAT SINK is blocked, preventing access by employees for easy handwashing. OBSERVED HANDWASHING SINK NEAR 3-VAT SINK WITH A BAG OF DISH DETERGENT IN IT.
violations.corrective_action: A hand washing sink shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for employee use. CDI: DISH DETERGENT BAG REMOVED FROM SINK.

violations.title: Chemical Sanitization, Quaternary Ammonium Requirements
violations.observation: When tested, the quaternary ammonium compound-based sanitizing solution was observed to be at a concentration less than what is required for effective sanitization of food-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils. Observed the sanitizing solution in the THREE-VAT SINK with a concentration of ~100 ppm total quaternary ammonium compound.
violations.corrective_action: The quaternary ammonium sanitizer used in this facility shall have a minimum concentration of at least 200 ppm OR a concentration between 150-400ppm based on the manufacturer's use directions and using the appropriate test kit. CDI: SANITIZER NOT BEING USED. EMERGENCY CALL TO ECOLAB BY MANAGER WAS MADE. CFM WILL USE SANITIZER STRAIGHT FROM BUCKET BEFORE ECOLAB COMES.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: OBSERVED WET WIPING CLOTHS TO BE STORED IN WATER WITHOUT ANY SANITIZER.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. CDI: BUCKETS DUMPED. CFM RE-EDUCATED. WILL BE FILLED WITH SANITIZER SOLUTION UPON FIXING OF SANITIZING EQUIPMENT.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: OBSERVED THE SANITIZING EQUIPMENT TO NOT BE WORKING PROPERLY AND ONLY SANITIZING ~100PPM. OBSERVED THE DISH DETERGENT EQUIPMENT NOT WORKING CORRECTLY AND REQUIRING MANUAL POURING FROM BULK BAG. OBSERVED THE VEGGIE WASH EQUIPMENT TO ALSO BE IN DISREPAIR/NOT WASHING AT ANY CONCENTRATION.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. SANITIZING EQUIPMENT MUST BE REPAIRED AS SOON AS POSSIBLE. MANAGER CALLED FOR REPAIR AT TIME OF INSPECTION. YOU MUST NOT USE CURRENT SANITIZER UNLESS IT IS SANITIZING PER MANUFACTURER INSTRUCTIONS OF 150PPM-400PPM OR 200PPM-400PPM. BLEACH (CHLORINE) MAY BE USED TO SANITIZE WITH A CONCENTRATION OF 50-200PPM.OTHER ITEMS MUST ALSO BE REPAIRED TO WORK PROPERLY/AS INTENDED BY THE MANUFACTURER.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: OBSERVED AN UNAPPROVED SPLITTER ON THE MOP SINK.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. CDI: SPLITTER UNINSTALLED. CEASE USING UNAPPROVED SPLITTERS AND UTILIZE A PRESSURE BLEED VALVE INSTEAD.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: sausage 50F and Italian sausage 50 F
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC disposed of TCS items

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Sanitizers, Criteria
violations.observation: The concentration of the @SANITIZER@ solution was measured at @##@ ppm. This concentration exceeds the approved limits for use with food-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils in a foodservice establishment. EH observed quaternary ammonia at 500ppm
violations.corrective_action: Maintain the concentration of @SANITIZER@ solution at @##@ppm. Verify concentration using the appropriate test kit. PIC corrected sinister level to 400 ppm

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: 3 dr refrigerated prep top (44°F)
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly.
